items.title: Dawoud Sabu Adeyola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 30, 2025
items.q: Louis Hayes on drums. So I had a good, you know, it was like my coming out party. That’s the first jazz concert I ever went to.

ctx.x: People who know me know that my favorite LP is Nancy Wilson and Cannonball Adderley.

Oh, that’s a great album. They had just made that album, for Capitol Records, when they came to Kleinhans, and it was a double bill because George Shearing was on the first half, and then Cannonball’s quintet was on the second, and with Cannonball, his brother © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-

Nat, Yusef Lateef, Joe Zawinul, one of my very favorite mentors, Sam Jones on bass, and Louis Hayes on drums. So I had a good, you know, it was like my coming out party. That’s the first jazz concert I ever went to.
